findings.summary: `rename` fetches the document with `self.repo.get(doc_id)` without an ownership check (unlike `read`, `update_body` and `delete`, which use `self._owned`), so any user can rename another user's document and probe which ids exist because no `NotFound` is raised.

judge.reason: Same defect: rename uses repo.get instead of _owned, allowing cross-user rename and id probing.

findings.label: hit
